resale_co.name: Residential Dwelling Re-occupancy Inspection / Re-occupancy Certificate
resale_co.issued_by: Vernon Township Department of Fire Prevention (Fire Prevention Bureau)
resale_co.lead_time: Fee tiers count business days between the Fire Prevention Bureau's receipt of the application and the closing; more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. Mailed applications count from the day the Bureau receives them. The inspection is scheduled once the completed application and fee are received.
requirements: Re-occupancy inspection before a 1 or 2 family dwelling is sold, leased or changes occupancy (Code Section 250-21)

Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of a bedroom on each level
At least one portable fire extinguisher, no more than 10 lbs, labeled 2A10BC, within 10 feet of the kitchen (Township page still lists it)

Construction Records Clearance Application filed with the Building Department
Vacant and Abandoned Residential Properties Approval Sheet signed by the Zoning Officer or the Clerk's office, for every re-occupancy request

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill in three forms completely: the Re-occupancy & Smoke Detector Certification Application (Fire Prevention), the Construction Records Clearance Application (Building Department) and the Vacant & Abandoned Residential Properties Approval Sheet (signed by the Zoning Officer or Clerk). Drop them off or mail them with payment to Vernon Township, 21 Church Street, Vernon, NJ 07462. Fire Prevention takes exact cash, check or money order payable to Vernon Township. An after-hours drop box is at the rear of the building by the police station (no cash). Fire Prevention then schedules the inspection.

resale_co.notes: Vernon combines the town re-occupancy inspection and the state smoke/CO certificate in one Fire Prevention inspection. The FAQ fee tiers are worded slightly differently from the page and form ($100 if closing is 11 or more business days from receipt, $150 for 5 to 10, $200 for 4 or less). The $25 re-occupancy checklist fee is quoted from the Code on the Fire Inspections page; it is not clear whether it is included in the $100 to $200 total shown on the form. The Construction Records Clearance tiers use calendar days, not business days. A failed or missed inspection means paying the fee again. The application PDFs are scans, so their quotes cannot be checked by script. A change of tenant also needs the long-term rental registration; rental-only. Lake community associations (for example Highland Lakes) may have their own rules; those are not Township requirements.

other_items.label: Construction Records Clearance

other_items.label: Vacant and abandoned property sign-off
other_items.detail: The Vacant and Abandoned Residential Properties Approval Sheet must be signed by the Zoning Officer or the Clerk's office before the re-occupancy inspection is scheduled, even if the home is not vacant.
